updateSteps.1:
1. Update your local copy:
   cd <path-to-RadiProtocol-Library>
   git checkout main
   git pull origin main
updateSteps.2:
2. Create a new branch for your changes:
   git checkout -b my-changes
updateSteps.3:
3. Make changes through the admin panel
   (creating folders, importing snippets/protocols, editing metadata).
   Indexes are rebuilt automatically.
updateSteps.4:
4. Review changes:
   git status
   git diff
updateSteps.5:
5. Commit and push:
   git add .
   git commit -m "description of changes"
   git push origin my-changes
updateSteps.6:
6. Create a Pull Request on GitHub:
   Go to the repository page → Pull Requests tab → New pull request → select your branch.
